rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 3AB, correctly noting compact ICM and looser TE, but includes speculative details from a single image such as fragmentation, zona irregularities, and debris that may not be clearly visible.

Integrates age, AMH, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, diagnosis, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are broad rather than deeply individualized.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are inconsistencies and distracting tangents (e.g., frozen-thawed option to lower costs, discussion of transferring two embryos, mixed implantation/live birth ranges) that weaken coherence.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer, caution about untested embryos, and avoiding unsupported add-ons, but includes some questionable or nonstandard suggestions and imprecise statements that are not tightly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, alcohol cessation, follow-up hCG/ultrasound, and when to consider PGT-A or further review.
